statements.proposition: The files changed by this pull request pass flake8 (the project's configured linter), and the change follows existing project patterns.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: flake8 7.5.0 (pycodestyle 2.15.0, Python 3.13.5) with the repo's tox.ini [flake8] config reports nothing for the new command file. For ingest/tests.py it reports 18 E201/E202 findings, all in f-string expressions like f"{ project.id }" in lines at or before about line 470, outside the added hunk near line 894; the identical findings appear with the base version of ingest/tests.py, so they are pre-existing and appear to be an artefact of the newer pycodestyle on Python 3.13 f-strings. No GitHub check-runs were listed to confirm CI's result. 'Follows existing project patterns' is a style judgment not checked beyond the lint.
